svg.text: motor_driver_1TB6612FNG dual DC motor driver module
motor_driver_2TB6612FNG dual DC motor driver module
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 7.2 V from SW1: load 3.041 A typical, 7.441 A peak; source 20 A cont, 100 A peak; fuse 4 A
5V_LOGIC 5 V from A1: load 0.029 A typical, 0.029 A peak; source 0.2 A cont, 0.4 A peak
5V_SERVO 5 V from U1: load 0.81 A typical, 2.61 A peak; source 2 A cont, 3 A peak
5V_ARMS 5 V from U2: load 0.9 A typical, 2.7 A peak; source 2 A cont, 3 A peak
Fuses: F1 4 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch controller), F3 2 A (branch servo_regulator), F4 2 A (branch arm_regulator). Branch fuses sit inline in the
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_vbat, splice_5v_logic, splice_5v_arms) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
